topic: 学习目标与学习习惯 · Independent new scenario: comparing two study routines
grammarFocus: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do / does 问句。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.

title: Two Study Routines: A New Week, A New Plan
instructions: 这是为A2学习者设计的原创模拟阅读材料（非官方雅思测试）。请先通读短文，注意一般现在时与现在进行时的区别，以及频率副词和do/does问句。然后完成8道阅读题，再学习语法讲解并完成8道语法题，最后进行口语和写作练习。所有题目答案必须来自短文或语法规则，不要凭个人经验作答。
passage:
A. Lin and Maya are classmates in an English class. They are talking about study routines this week. Lin says, 'I usually study in the morning. I get up at six and read for thirty minutes. I always write new words in a small notebook.' Maya says, 'I rarely study in the morning. I often study at night. I usually listen to English songs before bed.'

B. This week is different. Lin is studying at night because she has a morning job. She is drinking tea and reading a story now. Maya is studying in the morning this week. She is sitting at the kitchen table and writing sentences. 'I am not watching TV now,' she says. 'I am doing my homework.'

C. Their teacher, Mr. Chen, asks, 'Do you study every day?' Lin answers, 'Yes, I do. I study for one hour every day.' Maya says, 'No, I don't. I study for two hours on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. I never study on Sunday.' Mr. Chen says, 'Good. Do you always use a notebook?' Lin says, 'Yes, I always do.' Maya says, 'I sometimes use a notebook, but I usually use my phone.'

D. Lin and Maya want to improve their English. Lin says, 'I want to learn ten new words every day.' Maya says, 'I am learning to write a diary in English this month. I write three sentences every night.' They both agree: a good routine helps.

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常性、习惯性的动作或事实，常与always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never等频率副词连用。例如：I usually study in the morning. 第三人称单数动词要加-s或-es。现在进行时表示现在正在进行的动作，结构是am/is/are + 动词-ing。例如：She is drinking tea now. 问句：一般现在时用do/does提问，例如：Do you study every day? Does she study at night? 回答用Yes, I do. / No, I don't. 注意：频率副词通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。
grammar.example: I usually study in the morning. She is drinking tea and reading a story now. Do you study every day?

questions.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语she是第三人称单数，动词study要变为studies。
现在进行时结构为be + 动词-ing，主语they用are。
一般现在时第三人称单数问句用Does开头。

questions.prompt: I ______ watch TV in the morning.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时否定句，主语I用don't + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: I don't watch TV in the morning.

questions.explanation: Look! 提示动作正在进行，用现在进行时is asking。
questions.evidence: Look! The teacher is asking a question.

questions.explanation: 频率副词never放在实义动词goes之前。
questions.evidence: She never goes to bed early.

questions.prompt: They ______ (study) English now. (用所给动词的适当形式填空)
questions.explanation: now表示现在正在进行，主语they用are studying。

questions.prompt: ______ you usually read at night? (用do或does填空)
questions.explanation: 主语you，一般现在时问句用Do开头。
questions.evidence: Do you usually read at night?

speaking.part2: Describe your study routine. You should say: when you usually study; where you study; what you do first; and how you feel about your routine.
part3: Do you think a good routine is important? Why?

transfer.writing: Write 5–7 sentences about your study routine this week. Use always, usually, sometimes, or never. Use one sentence in the present continuous (now).
